test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 44

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 7 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 14 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?

A man purchased two varieties of pencils at the rate of ₹8 for 9 pencils and ₹8 per pencil, respectively. If he purchased an equal number of pencils of each variety and then sold all his pencils at ₹6 per pencil, what was his profit percentage?

A man spends 50% of his monthly salary (in ₹) on the rent of his house. If every month, he also spends ₹607 on his conveyance and ₹2363 on his grocery, and saves the remaining ₹783, his monthly salary (in ₹) is:
The average screen time of a group of 8 friends is  4h, 6h, 5h, 4h, 5h, 5h, 5h and 6h. What is their average screen time?
The odometer of a car reads 12,100 km at the start of a trip and 12,640 km at its end. If the trip took 6 hours, then the average speed of car in m/sec is:
Ashish has borrowed an amount of ₹2,80,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 7% per annum after 4 years?

A and B started moving at the same time towards each other from points X and Y, respectively. After meeting on the way, A and B took 93.6 hours and p hours, respectively, to reach Y and X, respectively. If the speed of B is 50% more than that of A, then what is the value of p?
A manufacturer fixes his selling price at 20% over the cost of production. If the cost of production goes up by 50%, and the manufacturer raises his selling price by 40%, find the profit percentage.
A cosmetic product is available at a discount of 11%. If the shopkeeper charges ₹1,602, what is its marked price (in ₹)?
